name: Discover
desc: Workshops, audits and interviews to find what actually limits growth.

name: Define
desc: Scope, success metrics and a fixed plan everyone signs off on.

name: Design
desc: Wireframes to high-fidelity UI, prototyped and tested.

name: Build
desc: Weekly releases to a staging link you can click through.

name: Automate
desc: Connect CRM, email, payments and ops so work runs itself.

name: Launch
desc: QA, performance and SEO checks, then a calm go-live.

name: Measure
desc: Tracking and dashboards from day one, reviewed every fortnight.

name: Scale
desc: Iterate on what the numbers say, add channels, grow the system.
